description: Review a code diff for SFMC (AMPscript, SSJS, or HTML) quality issues. Extracts added/changed lines from the diff and validates them. Returns structured feedback with line-level diagnostics and style suggestions.

diff.description: A unified diff (git diff format) containing the changed code.

language.description: Language of the changed file. Defaults to "auto" for automatic detection.

maxProblems.description: Maximum number of problems to report (default 50).

name: review_change
